notes.title: Morningtide Motel is Available Now!!
notes.content:
We are so excited to announce that our latest game, Morningtide Motel, now available on Steam! This game was a labor of love from so many people, and we are so glad to be able share our team's hard work with the world. We hope you enjoy managing your motel, checking in customers, attending to their needs, and learning about their lives throughout this game!

Please share your thoughts with us on [url=https://twitter.com/slandercastdev] Twitter [/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/slandercaststudio/] Instagram [/url]! Leaving a rating or review on our  
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/] Steam Page [/url] would help us out a ton. Additionally, we really value any bug reports and feedback, so if you encounter any issues, you can email as at dev@slandercast.studio or fill out [url=https://forms.gle/itQCQ74P5xoRi74D8]our bug report form here[/url].

Thank you for playing!

-Slandercast Studio

☀️🌙🏨👁️

notes.title: Morningtide Motel Demo OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
In case you missed it - [i]Slandercast Studio is back with another game![/i] [b]Morningtide Motel [/b]is a narrative-driven motel management game, where you chat with customers, check them into your motel, and learn more about a strange curse that is falling over your country. With so much to do, you find yourself pulling all-nighter after all-nighter, and after weeks of tireless, sleepless nights, you begin wonder… could you even fall asleep if you tried?

[h2]The Demo is Available Now![/h2]

The full release of Morningtide Motel is coming up soon, and in preparation, we are taking part in this months Steam Next Fest! As such, [b]the demo for Morningtide Motel is now available to play[/b], right on the Morningtide Motel store page! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/]Please consider checking it out![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/

As always, thank you so much for playing, and we hope you enjoy [b]Morningtide Motel![/b]

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 2: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Thanks again to everyone who has supported At Winter’s End — we are so grateful to everyone who has played our game, and are excited to bring it to even more of you! We have a handful of small updates for you, and are excited to announce that [b]At Winter’s End is now officially Steam Deck Compatible![/b] Enjoy!

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue stopping achievements from unlocking on Mac
[*] Tweaked input glyphs and tutorials to be more platform-agnostic
[*] Fixed “Report Issue” button not working on certain devices
[*] Fixed certain menu behavior to no longer be framerate dependent
[/list]

notes.title: At Winter's End Original Soundtrack – Steam Release!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce the release of the soundtrack for At Winter’s End, composed by the illustrious Keeper of the Sound, Braden Hajer! The soundtrack is available FOR FREE on Steam as .mp3s as well as high quality .wavs. The soundtrack will also be available on all major music streaming services in a few weeks.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2732110/At_Winters_End_Soundtrack/]At Winter's End Soundtrack[/url]

Thank you so much to everyone who has played and supported At Winter’s End so far, and to all those who will play it in the years to come. We are excited to continue working on exciting new projects and games together!

-Slandercast Studio
🎵 🌱 🦉 ❤️‍🔥 🎵

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for the support, we're really happy to see you all enjoying At Winter's End! The update today is pretty minor, just fixing a couple of small issues we've noticed.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Day 3 story branch logic
[*] Fixed an issue with Day 3 achievement unlocks
[*] Tweaked colliders in Capybara's Hollow and Pond
[/list]

notes.title: At Winter's End OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We here at Slandercast Studio are proud to announce the release of our first game on Steam, At Winter's End! This game was a culmination of many weeks of hard work from many different people, and we're very happy with what our team was able to accomplish. We hope you all enjoy exploring the forest with Noel as they roll dice, help out the spirits of the forest, and discover what growing up is like. 

Please share your thoughts with us on [url=https://twitter.com/slandercastdev] Twitter [/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/slandercaststudio/] Instagram [/url]! Leaving a rating or review on our
